title: Device for controlling the function of a vacuum lifting device, and vacuum lifting device having such a control device

features.item: single-hand portable design with all components carried by rigid body without external hose or cord
features.quote: An operating element attached to the tube lifter's lower end is used to manually control the tube lifter. It enables the one-handed control of the suctioning, lifting, lowering and subsequent release of the load.
features.note: The quote describes one-handed control, implying a portable design, but does not explicitly state that all components are carried by a rigid body without external hoses or cords, nor does it explicitly state it's a single-hand portable design for the entire lifting device.

overall.why: The reference describes a control device for a vacuum lifting device with some overlapping features like a suction means and one-handed control, but lacks key aspects of the subject invention such as cordless operation, integrated battery power, and specific warning indicators for vacuum levels.
